scale: Each criterion is scored 0–4 against the published rubric: 0 = absent, 1 = minimal, 2 = partial, 3 = strong, 4 = best-in-class. Dimension score = mean of its criteria × 25 (0–100). Composite = weighted sum of dimension scores.

dimensions.name: Autonomy
dimensions.definition: How much of the sourcing loop the tool runs without a recruiter driving each step.

criteria.name: Autonomous search
criteria.definition: Initiates and continuously runs candidate searches from a role brief without per-search recruiter operation.

criteria.name: Autonomous screening
criteria.definition: Evaluates candidates against role criteria and produces accept/reject decisions with reasoning, rather than only ranking results for manual review.

criteria.name: Autonomous outreach
criteria.definition: Composes and sends personalized outreach and follow-ups without per-message recruiter action.

criteria.name: Scheduling automation
criteria.definition: Handles candidate replies through to a booked interview (Q&A, availability, calendar booking).

dimensions.name: Matching & screening depth
dimensions.definition: Quality and adaptability of candidate evaluation.

criteria.name: Structured criteria evaluation
criteria.definition: Evaluates against explicit role-specific criteria with per-candidate reasoning, beyond keyword/Boolean relevance.

criteria.name: Learning from feedback
criteria.definition: Adapts its matching per role from recruiter/hiring-manager feedback.

criteria.name: Hard requirements
criteria.definition: Supports mandatory criteria that are never relaxed (certifications, clearances, locations).

criteria.name: Trajectory & context inference
criteria.definition: Reads career trajectory, company caliber, and inferred attributes rather than title/keyword matches.

dimensions.name: Outreach & engagement
dimensions.definition: Ability to convert sourced profiles into responsive candidates.

criteria.name: Personalization
criteria.definition: Per-candidate AI personalization grounded in the candidate's actual background.

criteria.name: Sequencing
criteria.definition: Multi-step sequences, scheduling windows, and testing.

criteria.name: Reply handling
criteria.definition: Automated handling of candidate questions and replies.

dimensions.name: Coverage & data
dimensions.definition: Breadth of candidate discovery and contact data.

criteria.name: Source breadth
criteria.definition: Discovery beyond a single network: open web, GitHub, publications, licensed partners.

dimensions.name: Workflow & integrations
dimensions.definition: Fit into the surrounding recruiting stack.

criteria.name: ATS integrations
criteria.definition: Breadth and depth of ATS/CRM sync.
